name: Fingered bass
credit: Black And Blue Basses — Karoryfer Samples
_what: The black hollowbody, played with the fingers. Karoryfer sample it at
every semitone with four round robins and four dynamics, which is more
of everything than a bank can hold; what this recipe does is choose.
THE OCTAVE. The library is mapped and named an octave above what it
sounds: `darkblack_e2` is written at key 40 and its fundamental is
41.3 Hz, which is E1 and MIDI 28. `key_offset` is that correction and
the tool measures the fundamental of every note it writes, because a
bank an octave out is in tune with itself and wrong with the band.
_notes: Six notes a fifth apart, which covers E1 to G3 with nothing further
than two semitones from a sample — well inside the three the engine
allows, and E2 is one of them because that is the note the engine's own
Why not denser. Every one of these files runs to the 2.0 s cap: a bass
note does not get 60 dB down inside two seconds, so the tail search
never fires and 188 KB is what a note costs whatever pitch it is. Six
notes at three layers and two round robins is 36 files and 6.6 MB;
sampling every third semitone, which is what the loader's own comment
sizes a bank at, would be sixty files and 11.3 MB — past the 4-8 MB
this voice is allowed and 23 MB resident once the engine builds the
_layers: The library has four dynamics and the bank keeps three of them, chosen
by measured loudness rather than by name — see render_voice's point 3.
5.5 dB is the middle of the 5-6 dB the brief asks for.
_release: which is also the longest the loader accepts. A wound string under a
finger does not stop when the finger does.
